Best in Travel Winner

Prince Edward Island, Canada

Best in Travel 2027 winner Prince Edward Island rewards visitors with some of North America’s softest beaches and most stunning coastal scenery. A seafood lover’s paradise, it’s the place to catch your own dinner – by oyster tonging, lobster trapping, mackerel fishing or mussel gathering.

Best in Travel 2027
